Let executer be the acting enemy of arg.
If executer's 'constraint' → get-force-ability-id is the id of the move labelled "ultima" on executer, then executer uses the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI immediately with options {sequence: [[{messageSuffixNo: "01"}]]}.
Call game:ai.stateSnippet.HpRateTransitionV2.helper.registerAbility.apply with (this state, arguments).
